title: Spec P23 fractional-NFT pools: vault, whitelist, oracle, caps, live-blocked posture
description: Deliverable: docs/spec/P23_ARCHITECTURE.md for fractionalized NFT yield pools: collection whitelist registry (48 h timelock), utilization-cap enforcer (0.75), fractional vault (ERC-20 shares), NFT pricing oracle adapter (7-day TWAP, 2+ sources), and the live-blocked posture (live_blocked=True, no live intents ever). Acceptance: (1) fractionalization model defined with share-mint formula and 1e3 minimum-shares burn; (2) whitelist governance and cap math (0.75 utilization, 0.08 per-collection, 60% max LTV, 75% liquidation threshold) written as implementable numbers; (3) live-blocked stated as a hard invariant with LiveBlocked semantics. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Define P23 Solidity + Python interfaces (vault, registry, oracle)
description: Deliverable: Solidity interfaces in onchain/src/p23/interfaces/ (IFractionalVault, ICollectionRegistry, INftPricingOracle) and Python protocols in src/sincor2/defi/p23/interfaces.py. Acceptance: (1) Solidity interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24; (2) Python protocols type-check and cover deposits, redemptions, whitelist ops, and price queries; (3) interface docs state the live-blocked constraint on every state-changing path. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P23 economics: 15% APR, 20 bps fee, caps, worked per-pool example
description: Deliverable: docs/spec/P23_ECONOMICS.md with target_apr=0.15, fee_bps=20 on realized per-pool yield, risk_score bound 0.65, max_alloc_pct=0.08 per collection, utilization cap 0.75, min_capital_usd=400.0. Acceptance: (1) worked example: $1M pool at 15% -> $150,000/yr -> $300.00/yr fee (net 14.97%), matching fee math to the cent; (2) utilization-cap formula and per-collection cap stated as equations the enforcer implements verbatim; (3) borrower terms quantified (60% max LTV, 75% liquidation threshold, 24 h grace). Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Create P23 repo layout: onchain/src/p23/ + src/sincor2/defi/p23/
description: Deliverable: onchain/src/p23/ (vault, registry, oracle adapter, interfaces), src/sincor2/defi/p23/ (manager, interfaces), tests/pytest/test_p23_*.py stubs, configs/agents/p23-nftfi-pools.yaml, docs runbook stub. Acceptance: (1) solc 0.8.24 compiles the Solidity tree and the Python package imports cleanly; (2) layout mirrors the interface definitions from the spec phase; (3) agent YAML validates. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P23 starter boilerplate: vault stub, registry stub, mock oracle
description: Deliverable: FractionalVault stub with ReentrancyGuard, whitelist registry stub, mock pricing oracle returning fixed floors, Python monitor stub with TOA hooks. Acceptance: (1) solc compiles all stubs with zero warnings; (2) mock deposit/redeem round-trip works in Python against the mock oracle; (3) every stub's state-changing path is marked live-blocked in code comments. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the collection whitelist registry: 48 h timelock, freeze-on-removal
description: Deliverable: CollectionRegistry (Solidity + Python mirror): only allowlisted ERC-721 collections can back pools; add/remove via 48-hour timelocked admin; events on every change. Acceptance: (1) deposits for non-whitelisted collections revert in 100% of fuzzed cases; (2) timelock removal freezes new deposits within one block while existing redemptions keep working; (3) every whitelist change emits an event mirrored by the Python monitor. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the utilization-cap enforcer: 0.75 cap, withdrawals never blocked
description: Deliverable: utilization-cap enforcer with utilization = deployed_lending_value / total_pool_value <= 0.75; deposits breaching the cap revert; withdrawals never blocked; cap readable onchain. Acceptance: (1) cap-breach deposits revert, verified at utilizations 0.74/0.75/0.76; (2) withdrawals succeed at 0.99 utilization; (3) currentUtilization() and utilizationCap() return exact onchain values. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the fractional NFT vault: ERC-20 shares, NAV accrual, redemptions
description: Deliverable: FractionalVault.sol: ERC-721 custody, ERC-20 fractional share mint/burn against whitelisted deposits, borrower-interest NAV accrual, redemptions; ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, try/catch on oracle calls degrading to last-good-price (never bricking). Acceptance: (1) full deposit-accrue-redeem cycle on a local chain with share math matching the spec to the wei; (2) 1e3 minimum shares burned on first deposit (inflation-attack guard); (3) oracle failure freezes deposits but never bricks withdrawals. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the NFT pricing oracle: 7-day TWAP, 24 h breaker, 25% clamp
description: Deliverable: NftPricingOracle adapter with per-collection floor as 7-day TWAP from >=2 independent sources, 24-hour staleness circuit-breaker, and max 25% price move per update. Acceptance: (1) manipulated feeds (>25% single-update jump) are clamped and alert; (2) stale feeds (>24 h) freeze deposits and fall back to last-good-price without bricking the vault; (3) source divergence >15% alerts, >30% auto-freezes deposits (fork-tested). Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement 20 bps fee on realized per-pool yield to 0x09E289...9612Ac
description: Deliverable: fee module computing fee = floor(realized_epoch_yield_wei * 20 / 10000) per collection pool per 7-day epoch, routed to the canonical treasury with per-pool accounting. Acceptance: (1) fee math matches the P23_ECONOMICS.md $1M-pool worked example to the wei; (2) per-pool ledger attributes every wei to its collection; (3) settlement targets only 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Build the pool liquidity manager agent (dry-run advisory only)
description: Deliverable: src/sincor2/defi/p23/manager.py monitoring pool utilization, rebalancing advisory allocations across whitelisted collections within the 0.08 per-collection cap, emitting TOA feedback; dry-run only, never signs. Acceptance: (1) manager rebalances a mocked pool set without ever breaching a utilization cap; (2) per-collection exposure stays <=0.08 in all plans; (3) any live-intent path raises LiveBlocked. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the live-block gate: LiveBlocked on every live-intent path
description: Deliverable: live-block enforcement matching catalog live_blocked=True: the module never emits live intents; any live-intent code path raises LiveBlocked. Acceptance: (1) tests attempting live emission through every entrypoint (vault, registry, oracle, manager) all raise LiveBlocked; (2) dry-run paths unaffected (full deposit/redeem cycle works in dry-run); (3) a LiveBlocked raise emits a P0 security event. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P23 unit tests: registry, caps, share math, fees, live-block
description: Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p23_nftfi_pools_unit.py covering whitelist registry, utilization caps, vault share math, 20 bps fee math, and the live-block gate. Acceptance: (1) all tests pass; (2) Solidity coverage via forge and Python coverage >=85%; (3) share-math tests pin deposit-accrue-redeem to the wei. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P23 integration tests: whitelist->deposit->accrue->redeem cycle
description: Deliverable: end-to-end tests: whitelist to deposit to accrue to redeem with oracle price moves, cap enforcement under pressure, manager rebalancing. Acceptance: (1) green cycle with exact NAV accounting; (2) cap-breach deposits revert mid-cycle while withdrawals proceed; (3) stale-oracle injection freezes deposits without bricking the cycle. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P23 invariant/fuzz tests: 1000+ deposit/redeem/price sequences
description: Deliverable: property tests asserting (a) share supply backs to deposited NFT value within oracle tolerance, (b) utilization never exceeds 0.75, (c) every deposit references a whitelisted collection. Acceptance: (1) invariants hold over >=1000 randomized deposit/redeem/price sequences; (2) violations fail loudly with the offending sequence logged; (3) fixed fuzz seeds for reproducibility. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Run P23 mainnet-fork simulation with real NFT collection data
description: Deliverable: fork run of vault + oracle adapter against mainnet state with real NFT collection data, verifying pricing, caps, and the live-block gate. Acceptance: (1) completed run with valid pool state and exact accounting; (2) zero live intents emitted (asserted, not assumed); (3) oracle behaves within the 25% clamp / 24 h breaker spec under real data. Judged per specs/p23-nftfi-pools.md §Acceptance criteria.
